title: IPv6 SocketAddr in whois query param may not be URL-encoded
description:
addr.to_string() for IPv6 produces '[::1]:1234'. Square brackets are gen-delims in RFC 3986 and technically should be percent-encoded in query parameters. Verify whether tailscaled's Go HTTP handler parses [::1]:1234 correctly without encoding, or requires %5B::1%5D:1234. If tailscaled uses r.URL.Query().Get("addr") it will handle both. Needs test with IPv6 SocketAddr.

Files: crates/kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs whois() line ~162
